title: Belger Arts Center

services.name: Studio RentalS
services.desc: Our Studio is accessible seven days a week to current Renters within the hours: Monday - Thursday: 9AM - 9PMFriday - Sunday: 10AM - 6PM individual must have basic clay/ceramic knowledge and be able to work independently: must have taken minimum two Belger 4-week classes (24 hours with an instructor) or have equivalent experience. This level of rental is designed to be flexible-months paid for do not have to be consecutive (renters pay as they go). Free bisque firings (glaze firings are an seperate fee, see Reg/Walk-In Rate on the Kiln Firings

services.name: Kiln Firings
services.desc: If you’re looking for a way to fire ceramic work made outside our studio, we do allow walk-ins! There are two firing methods: use the flowchart below to determine which option best suits your needs: Ideal for anyone that requires a specific date of completion; this is the option to ensure personal deadlines are met. Kiln Renters will be taught our requirements for proper stacking during loading, how to program/start the computer, and proper unloading protocol within their pre-approved, scheduled time slots. No prior experience required! Please note that firing as a Walk-In customer does not include use of our studio

services.name: Adult Classes
services.desc: Glass blowing classes take place at the Belger Glass Annex(1219 E. 19th St., KCMO) Classes at the Belger Glass Annex will light your fire for working with glass. Classes are taught by experienced and knowledgeable instructors who blow glass professionally. Choose from four-week class sessions or weekend intensive options. Must be 18 years or older to enroll. If you need to change or cancel your glass class participation, please do so 8 or more days before your first scheduled class. There will be a $25 fee for cancelling or rescheduling within 7 days of your scheduled class. Once the class has begun, there can be no more refunds or rescheduling. If you do not reschedule and do not show up

services.name: Glass Blowing
services.desc: For glass blowing groups larger than 15 people, please email glass@belgerarts.org to discuss options. Some of the more complicated objects (tumblers, wine glasses, and pumpkins) have a lower maximum
